tools.name: method_get_account
tools.description: Who the API key acts as: the Method user behind it (id and name; use the id as an assignee). Also a cheap check that the key works. GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: method_list_tables
tools.description: List every table on this Method account (standard QuickBooks/Xero/Method tables and custom ones) with its source and whether it can be created, updated or deleted. Tables differ per account: call this before querying a table you are unsure of. GET /api/v1/tables.

tools.name: method_get_table_fields
tools.description: The exact field names of a table with type, whether required, creatable and mutable, and for dropdowns the table they reference. Use it to pick `select` fields and to name fields in create/update calls (names are case-sensitive and wrong ones are silently ignored). GET /api/v1/tables/{table}/fields.

tools.name: method_query_records
tools.description: Query any table (Customer, Contacts, Activity, Invoice, Estimate, Item, Users, custom tables ...). Always pass `select`. `filter` uses OData-style syntax: strings in single quotes, dates as '2026-05-26T00:00:00Z' with Z or an offset, operators eq ne lt gt le ge and or not, functions contains(Name,'x

tools.name: method_count_records
tools.description: How many records a table has, optionally matching a filter (same filter syntax as method_query_records). Cheap: call it before paging through a big table. GET /api/v1/tables/{table}/count.

tools.name: method_get_record
tools.description: One record by RecordID from any table. Pass `select` to limit the columns; `expand` names a related CHILD table whose rows are embedded (e.g. InvoiceLine on Invoice; at most 50 rows); a parent such as a contact's Entity is not expanded: read it with its own RecordID (Entity_RecordID). GET /api/v1/ta

tools.name: method_search_customers
tools.description: Find customers and leads (the Customer table: Customers & Leads in Method) by text in the name or email, by lead/customer type, or list them all. Returns RecordID, name, email, phone, lead flag and status; override `select` for other fields (see method_get_table_fields with table Customer). Page wit

tools.name: method_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people), optionally those of one customer/lead entity (entity_id = the Customer's RecordID) or matching text in name/email/phone. Returns RecordID, name, email, phone, the entity link and active flag. Use a Contact's RecordID (not the Customer's) when linking activities. GET /api/v1/t

tools.name: method_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (calls, emails, to-dos, notes), newest first. Filter by the entity they belong to, the assigned user or a due-date window. The note text is in Comments. Override `select` for other fields (method_get_table_fields with table Activity). GET /api/v1/tables/Activity.

tools.name: method_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, newest first, optionally only unpaid ones (BalanceRemaining > 0), one customer's (customer_id = Customer RecordID) or created since a time. Returns reference number, customer, dates, amount and balance; override `select` for other fields. For totals use method_query_records with `appl

tools.name: method_list_files
tools.description: List the files attached to a record (name, size, who added it, id). Use the id with method_get_file_url. GET /api/v1/files.

tools.name: method_get_file_url
tools.description: A temporary download link (valid 20 minutes) for an attached file, by the file id from method_list_files. The link works without the API key: share it only with someone allowed to see the file. GET /api/v1/files/{id}/url.

tools.name: method_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: creates a record in Method's Customer table. is_lead true = a Customer Lead (does not sync to the accounting system); is_lead false = a full customer, which Method syncs to QuickBooks/Xero (it appears there too). Method also creates the primary Contact; its RecordID is returned as contact_id

tools.name: method_create_activity
tools.description: WRITE: logs an activity (call, email, to-do, note) on a customer/lead. entity_id is the Customer RecordID; contact_id is the Contact RecordID (not the Customer's; method_list_contacts finds it). The text goes in Comments. Prefer activity_type_id (read it from an existing activity of that type) over

tools.name: method_create_record
tools.description: WRITE: creates a record in any table that allows it (method_list_tables shows canCreate), e.g. Estimate, Invoice, Item, Vendor. For customers/leads and activities use the dedicated tools. Field names are case-sensitive and a wrong one is silently ignored: read them with method_get_table_fields first

tools.name: method_update_record
tools.description: WRITE: changes fields on one record (PATCH: only the fields you pass change). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: method_search_customers, method_list_contacts, method_list_activities, method_get_file_url, method_create_customer, method_create_activity, method_create_record · Private data: method_get_account, method_query_records, method_count_records, method_get_record, method_list_contacts, method_list_files, method_get_file_url, method_create_customer, method_create_activity, method_create_record, method_update_record · Public sink: method_search_customers, method_list_contacts, method_get_file_url, method_create_customer, method_create_activity, method_create_record · Destructive: method_update_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: method_search_customers, method_list_contacts, method_list_activities, method_get_file_url, method_create_customer, method_create_activity, method_create_record · Private data: method_get_account, method_query_records, method_count_records, method_get_record, method_list_contacts, method_list_files, method_get_file_url, method_create_customer, method_create_activity, method_create_record, method_update_record · Public sink: method_search_customers, method_list_contacts, method_get_file_url, method_create_customer, method_create_activity, method_create_record · Destructive: method_update_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
